entries.title: Psalms 104:1
segments: ¶Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great: You are clothed with honor and majesty,

entries.title: Psalms 104:2
segments: Who cover [Yourself] with light as [with] a garment, Who stretch out the heavens like a curtain.

entries.title: Psalms 104:3
segments: He lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters, Who makes the clouds His chariot, Who walks on the wings of the wind,

entries.title: Psalms 104:4
segments: Who makes His angels spirits, His ministers a flame of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 104:5
segments: [You who] laid the foundations of the earth, So [that] it should not be moved forever,

entries.title: Psalms 104:6
segments: You covered it with the deep as [with] a garment; The waters stood above the mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 104:7
segments: At Your rebuke they fled; At the voice of Your thunder they hastened away.

entries.title: Psalms 104:8
segments: They went up over the mountains; They went down into the valleys, To the place which You founded for them.

entries.title: Psalms 104:9
segments: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, That they may not return to cover the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 104:10
segments: ¶He sends the springs into the valleys, They flow among the hills.

entries.title: Psalms 104:11
segments: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

entries.title: Psalms 104:12
segments: By them the birds of the heavens have their home; They sing among the branches.

entries.title: Psalms 104:13
segments: He waters the hills from His upper chambers; The earth is satisfied with the fruit of Your works.

entries.title: Psalms 104:14
segments: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, And vegetation for the service of man, That he may bring forth food from the earth,

entries.title: Psalms 104:15
segments: And wine [that] makes glad the heart of man, Oil to make [his] face shine, And bread [which] strengthens man's heart.

entries.title: Psalms 104:16
segments: The trees of the LORD are full [of sap], The cedars of Lebanon which He planted,

entries.title: Psalms 104:17
segments: Where the birds make their nests; The stork has her home in the fir trees.

entries.title: Psalms 104:18
segments: The high hills [are] for the wild goats; The cliffs are a refuge for the rock badgers.

entries.title: Psalms 104:19
segments: ¶He appointed the moon for seasons; The sun knows its going down.

entries.title: Psalms 104:20
segments: You make darkness, and it is night, In which all the beasts of the forest creep about.

entries.title: Psalms 104:21
segments: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.

entries.title: Psalms 104:22
segments: [When] the sun rises, they gather together And lie down in their dens.

entries.title: Psalms 104:23
segments: Man goes out to his work And to his labor until the evening.

entries.title: Psalms 104:24
segments: O LORD, how manifold are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all. The earth is full of Your possessions-

entries.title: Psalms 104:25
segments: This great and wide sea, In which [are] innumerable teeming things, Living things both small and great.

entries.title: Psalms 104:26
segments: There the ships sail about; [There is] that Leviathan Which You have made to play there.

entries.title: Psalms 104:27
segments: These all wait for You, That You may give [them] their food in due season.

entries.title: Psalms 104:28
segments: [What] You give them they gather in; You open Your hand, they are filled with good.

entries.title: Psalms 104:29
segments: You hide Your face, they are troubled; You take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.

entries.title: Psalms 104:30
segments: You send forth Your Spirit, they are created; And You renew the face of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 104:31
segments: ¶May the glory of the LORD endure forever; May the LORD rejoice in His works.

entries.title: Psalms 104:32
segments: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the hills, and they smoke.

entries.title: Psalms 104:33
segments: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

entries.title: Psalms 104:34
segments: May my meditation be sweet to Him; I will be glad in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 104:35
segments: May sinners be consumed from the earth, And the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul! Praise the LORD!
